display.purpose: Hero headlines, universe portals; tight-tracked, may be caps-mode.

body.purpose: Editorial copy and functional text — Playfair carries both.

label.purpose: Satoshi tracked-caps eyebrows, badges, counts, facet chips ONLY.

shadows.name: ambient-hover
shadows.purpose: Card hover lift, paired with translate-y.

shadows.name: universe-glow-gold
shadows.purpose: Universe-card identity glow only — never ambient.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-on-paper commerce CTA — the quiet choice.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-ink, #141414); color: var(--color-cream, #f7f5f0); font-family: var(--font-serif, 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif); font-size: 17px; padding: 12px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #333; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #d95d39); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Universe Gold Button
components.description: Themed-zone CTA — gold remaps to the active universe's accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: var(--color-gold, #cba043); color: var(--on-gold, #f7f5f0); font-family: var(--font-serif, 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif); font-size: 17px; padding: 12px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s ease-out, gap .3s ease-out; } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: var(--color-gold-hover, #b8b043); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #d95d39); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Facet Chip
components.description: Fully-round pill; selected state is ink inversion (base) or gold fill (themed zones).
components.css: .ds-chip { background: var(--color-paper, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #141414); border: 1px solid var(--color-stone, #e5e1d8); border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Satoshi', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; padding: 8px 16px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s, background .2s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink, #141414); } .ds-chip-active { background: var(--color-ink, #141414); color: var(--color-cream, #f7f5f0); border-color: transparent; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #d95d39); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Intensity Meter
components.description: Signature metadata component — 3-segment Quiet↔Loud position, never a rating.
components.html: Loud
components.css: .ds-meter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-segment { display: block; width: 4px; height: 3px; background: var(--color-stone, #e5e1d8); } .ds-on { background: var(--color-gold-zari, #cba043); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Paper card over cream, hairline border, lift earned on hover only.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-paper, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-stone, #e5e1d8); border-radius: 2px; transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1), box-shadow .5s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1), border-color .5s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(20,20,20,.06); border-color: rgba(20,20,20,.5); } .ds-media { aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: var(--color-stone, #e5e1d8); } .ds-body { padding: 16px 20px; font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, serif); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Square field, drawn SVG icon, terracotta focus.
components.css: .ds-input { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--color-paper, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-stone, #e5e1d8); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-input svg { color: var(--color-stone, #e5e1d8); } .ds-input input { border: none; outline: none; font-family: var(--font-sans, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-ink, #141414); background: transparent; } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-accent, #d95d39); }

narrative.overview: A two-layer world: a stable cream-and-obsidian editorial base carrying every page's ergonomics, with per-universe ambient theming morphing accents and atmosphere without unmounting anything. Whitespace separates, hairlines group, depth is earned by interaction. Facet UI answers one question per filter: universe is where you are, garment chips are what kind of thing, intensity is how loudly you wear it, craft technique is provenance, edits are why you're shopping.
keyCharacteristics: Cream editorial canvas, hairline stone rules, zero hard borders by default
One serif does everything (Playfair Display); Satoshi exists only as tracked-out caps micro-labels
Depth is earned by interaction, never baked into rest state
Universe theming is ambient scope, not page replacement
Facet chips are fully-round pills; selected state = ink inversion (base) or gold fill (themed)

rules.name: The Champagne Rule
rules.body: Gold (#cba043) is never body text on light surfaces — light-ground gold appears only with gold-deep contrast tokens or as fills carrying on-gold text.

rules.name: The One-Serif Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a second editorial face; new voices come from weight, size, case, or italic — not family swaps.

rules.name: The Earned-Lift Rule
rules.body: Rest state: border only. Shadow + translate + scale arrive together as one interaction response. No resting shadows on cards.

dos: Do theme through tokens only: new universes = one JSON row + one [data-universe] CSS scope, zero component edits.
Do keep facet answers orthogonal — one question per filter.
Do carry aria-pressed on every chip, aria-label on every icon button, and 44px minimum touch targets.
donts: Don't use gold as text on light grounds or gold CTAs without the paired on-gold token.
Don't fabricate scarcity, ratings, or provenance — numbers render from catalog data or not at all.
Don't add Google Fonts or icon-font/emoji icons — self-hosted faces and drawn SVGs only.
Don't let universe theming leak into checkout/account surfaces.
